[h1] "You are the Hollow Knight"  [/h1]

I started playing it in high school on console and never knew what journey it would take me on, what rabbit holes I'd dig, how much time I would spend exploring around corners and battling tough bosses, and, of course, how much I would fall in love with it. Returning to this game as a uni student, I’m reminded of what mark this game left on me and how much it still means to me.

Hollow Knight is a beautifully hand-crafted journey for those who wish to explore, to those who want a challenge and to those who admire storytelling and art.  

If you’re reading this, I truly hope Hollow Knight resonates with you as deeply as it did with me. It’s more than just a game; it's an adventure.

This is an amazing game that I wanted to try for quite a bit but couldn't because of time, and man, what an entertaining piece of art this game is. I'm definitely getting Silksong after this.

Positives:

- Game is a metroidvania with a lot of personality.
- It takes elements for Souls games.
- Art is beautiful.
- Great variety of builds as you progress.

Negatives:

- Traversing can be a little tiring late into the game (this game definitely needs fast travel in more areas of the map)
- Trial of the Fool 3rd Stage is kinda idiotic... No way to heal while the floor has spikes and you have to fight airborne enemies.
- Soundtrack feels absent most of the time in the game.

I definitely recommend this game, especially because the base price is really cheap and you can get it at a much lower price with discounts. Such a great with an absolute fair price.

This game cannot be described in words like a review, it is experienced, and it's a must! 

The game starts with so dull atmosphere and you meet miserable characters. You enter the kingdom without any prior knowledge and uncover the mystery and lore of such a vast, advance bug kingdom. 

The game can seem very boring or rough in the beginning but once you start exploring and fight boss, you'll enjoy it , you'll have fun, a strong gameplay and a very good story. 

--->***## SPOILERS AHEAD, SKIP IT IF YOU DON'T WANT TO RUIN YOUR EXPERIENCE ##***<---

I personally loved the NPC Quirrel & Cloth the most, they are so Great 🥹🥹🥹🙌

And my favourite Bosses are : Watcher Knights, Failed Champion, Ogrim/Dung Defender, Mantis Lords, and yeah Obviously Massive Moss Charger & Gruz Mother (iykyk).

The ending caught me off guard, I didn't expected that, truly a Masterpiece, absolute cinema 🙌🥹

Though I haven't completed PoP, I'm sure I'll definitely some day.
